value.study: Haynes and Roberts 2015; 2019 Update #2 (CFTC OCE)
value.result: descriptive (automation shares); not a predictability test

value.study: Betancourt, Rodriguez and Boyd, arXiv 1710.01415 (JRSS-C 2019), NYMEX NG 2005-2008
value.result: positive for predicting future trader-to-trader transactions; not a price or order-book signal

value.study: Masteika and Vaitonis 2015, LNBIP, HFT calendar-spread statistical arbitrage on NYMEX NG
value.result: positive ('Statistical arbitrage and HFT has given positive results'); inter-contract spread rule, cost treatment unknown

value.study: Linn and Zhu 2004, J. Futures Markets, storage report and intraday volatility
value.result: volatility event effect; not directional, not order-book

value.study: Prokopczuk, Wese Simen and Wichmann 2021, Energy Journal, announcement-day returns
value.result: positive directional event drift after costs (abstract); not order-book

value.study: Borovkova and Mahakena 2015, Quantitative Finance, news, volatility and jumps
value.result: news Granger-causes jumps; not order-book

value.study: Chevallier and Sevi 2012, Energy Economics (WP), volume-volatility, NYMEX NG and CL
value.result: contemporaneous volume-volatility relation; not predictive

value.study: Pinto-Gutierrez 2012, SSRN 2139767, LOB information content in 'the electronic energy market'
value.result: unknown

value.study: Benato, MSc thesis Padova, LOB information content, EEX Germany Baseload power futures
value.result: positive in-sample, small ('even if it appears to be little'); no costs

value.study: CL studies collected by A1_crude (Raman-Robe-Yadav EMMs; Rousse-Sevi pre-EIA order flow; Roberts 2018 depth; Lalor-Swishchuk adverse selection)
value.result: pre-release buyer-initiated order flow before EIA (informed trading); no CL OFI or queue-imbalance price-prediction study found

value.study: ES OFI studies collected by C2_OFI
value.result: positive: 'both price and flow impacts are significant at the one-second horizon'

value.study: Program-internal E.12 Gate 0 and E.18 C1b replication (not published)
value.result: null: 'The best pair (NG h60, t 2.51) is not evidence after Holm'; replication 'C1b FAIL (E.18)'
